# check_qcells

> A Nagios/Icinga plugin for checking the state of charge of a PV plant battery.

The shell plugin queries inverter battery information through an API and reports warning and critical levels for battery state of charge. It requires curl and bc.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_qcells): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_qcells/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
